data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 1.2m (2013: surplus of GBP 1.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

named_events.loss_description: Superstorm Sandy hitting the North East coast of the US in late October; while wind speeds were not particularly high compared with major storms of the past, a number of factors combined to cause market losses.
An earthquake in Italy, which didn't have a particularly large impact on the overall result.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2014 year, Syndicate 557 closed with opening gross claims outstanding at GBP 47.212m. The syndicate recorded an adverse prior-year reassessment (a deficit) of GBP 1.2m (net), reflecting adverse prior-year claims development; no explicit gross prior-year movement was disclosed in the movement note, so the reported net deficit has been used as a fallback. The development was driven by adverse claims development in prior accident years. There are no quantified gross line-by-line reserve movements disclosed in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
a deficit of GBP 1.2m (2013: surplus of GBP 1.0m)
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was located in the notes for Syndicate 557. The document explicitly states a NET deficit of GBP 1.2m relating to prior accident years; per extraction rules this NET figure was used as a last-resort fallback because no gross movement note (Insurance liabilities column) was found. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes, but individual cell extraction was inconclusive from the images available; triangle presence is indicated but detailed numeric extraction was not possible. Users should treat the prior year development amount as NET of reinsurance and therefore lower confidence for gross prior-year quantification.
